name: Equipment type code qualifier
description: Code qualifying a type of equipment.

values.name: Ground equipment
values.description: Ground equipment Ground equipment being fuelled or serviced.

values.name: Chain
values.description: Chain Chain used in the securing of cargo.

values.name: Temperature recorder
values.description: Temperature recorder Temperature recorder to provide a record of the actual temperature.

values.name: Body trailer
values.description: Body trailer The part of the vehicle where the cargo is loaded.

values.name: Slipsheet
values.description: Slipsheet A cardboard platform used for holding product for storage or transportation.

values.name: No special equipment needed
values.description: No special equipment needed A code to indicate that there is no special equipment needed.

values.name: Vessel hold
values.description: Vessel hold A compartment forming part of a transport vessel.

values.name: Flat rack
values.description: Flat rack Type of open container used for carrying objects.

values.name: Aircraft
values.description: Aircraft To indicate that the equipment is an aircraft.

values.name: Medical device
values.description: Medical device A device used for medical purposes.

values.name: Refrigerated container
values.description: Refrigerated container A refrigerated (reefer) container that is actively cooling the product.

values.name: Synthetic pallet 80*120cm
values.description: Synthetic pallet 80*120cm A pallet with standard dimensions 80*120 centimetres made of synthetic material.

values.name: Synthetic pallet 100*120cm
values.description: Synthetic pallet 100*120cm A standard pallet with standard dimensions 100*120 centimetres made of synthetic material.

values.name: Clothing hanger rack
values.description: Clothing hanger rack Equipment used to store and transport clothing in a hanging position.

values.name: Road/rail trailer
values.description: Road/rail trailer Trailer designated for combined road/rail use.

values.name: Overhang wagon
values.description: Overhang wagon Empty rail wagon added to the loaded wagons, when goods are longer than the loaded wagon.

values.name: Blocks
values.description: Blocks A piece of equipment that is normally a piece of wood to fix cargo (e.g. coils) during transport.

values.name: Box pallet non-exchangeable
values.description: Box pallet non-exchangeable A box pallet which cannot be exchanged.

values.name: Truck being transported
values.description: Truck being transported A road vehicle capable of carrying goods which is being carried on another means of transport.

values.name: Truck and trailer combination being transported
values.description: Truck and trailer combination being transported A road vehicle capable of carrying goods with an attached trailer which is being carried on another means of transport.

values.name: Tractor and trailer being transported
values.description: Tractor and trailer being transported A trailer accompanied by a self-propelling tractor unit which is being carried on another means of transport.

values.name: Postal bag
values.description: Postal bag Bag intended primarily for the conveyance of postal items.

values.name: Letter Tray
values.description: Letter Tray Tray intended primarily for the conveyance of letter mail items of size slightly exceeding C5, in which the items are stood on their long edge.

values.name: Roller Cage
values.description: Roller Cage Wheeled wire cage.

values.name: Flats Tray
values.description: Flats Tray Tray intended primarily for the conveyance of letter mail items of from C5 up to in excess of C4, in which the items are stacked one on top of another. May also be used for letter mail smaller items stood on their long edge.

values.name: Out of bag parcel
values.description: Out of bag parcel Postal item which is conveyed individually, with only the wrapping provided by the mailer for protection.

values.name: Wheeled Platform
values.description: Wheeled Platform Device, consisting of a flat surface mounted on a wheels, which is designed for the conveyance of items which may safely be stacked. Normally also equipped with a handle to allow the device to be easily manoeuvred.

values.name: Container non-compliant with the Customs Convention on
values.description: Container non-compliant with the Customs Convention on Containers The container is not compliant with the Customs Convention on Containers.

values.name: Box pallet EUR Y non exchangeable
values.description: Box pallet EUR Y non exchangeable A euro-pallet of type Y that may not be exchanged.

values.name: Roll Pallet 1
values.description: Roll Pallet 1 80 X 60 cm pallet on casters.

values.name: Barge
values.description: Barge Flat bottomed inland cargo vessel for canals and rivers with or without own propulsion for the purpose of transported goods. (Synonym: Lighter).

values.name: Boxcar
values.description: Boxcar An enclosed railway goods wagon.

values.name: Chassis
values.description: Chassis A wheeled carriage onto which an ocean container is mounted for inland conveyance.

values.name: Container
values.description: Container Equipment item as defined by ISO for transport. It must be of: A) permanent character, strong enough for repeated use; B) designed to facilitate the carriage of goods, by one or more modes of transport, without intermediate reloading; C) fitted with devices for its ready handling, particularly.

values.name: Deadlight (panel)
values.description: Deadlight (panel) A set of panels fixed inside a porthole.

values.name: Roll Pallet 2
values.description: Roll Pallet 2 120 X 60 cm pallet on casters.

values.name: Container gantry crane
values.description: Container gantry crane A fixed gantry crane ashore for container handling operations.

values.name: Mobile crane
values.description: Mobile crane A mobile crane for handling operations.

values.name: Floating crane
values.description: Floating crane A crane mounted on a dedicated vessel.

values.name: Ship's equipment crane
values.description: Ship's equipment crane A crane mounted on a ship for handling operations.

values.name: Conveyor belt
values.description: Conveyor belt Rolling carpet belt.

values.name: Forklift
values.description: Forklift Equipment device for handling and moving goods.

values.name: Stacking equipment
values.description: Stacking equipment Equipment device for stacking goods.

values.name: Taillift
values.description: Taillift Equipment device at the rear of a truck for loading and unloading cargo.

values.name: Exchangeable EUR flat pallet
values.description: Exchangeable EUR flat pallet A flat euro-pallet that may be exchanged.

values.name: Exchangeable EUR Y box pallet
values.description: Exchangeable EUR Y box pallet A euro-pallet of type Y that may be exchanged.

values.name: Flat pallet EUR non exchangeable
values.description: Flat pallet EUR non exchangeable A flat euro-pallet that may not be exchanged.

values.name: Flat pallet (railway property) non-exchangeable
values.description: Flat pallet (railway property) non-exchangeable A non-exchangeable flat pallet owned by a railroad.

values.name: Lidded stackable rigid tray (CEN TS 14482:2002)
values.description: Lidded stackable rigid tray (CEN TS 14482:2002) Lidded stackable rigid tray compliant with CEN TS 14482:2002.

values.name: Lashing rope
values.description: Lashing rope A rope for lashing cargo.

values.name: Load/unload device on equipment
values.description: Load/unload device on equipment A mechanical device used in the loading and/or unloading of cargo into and from transport equipment.

values.name: Movable panel
values.description: Movable panel A panel which can be moved.

values.name: Pallet
values.description: Pallet A platform on which goods can be stacked in order to facilitate the movement by a forklift or sling.

values.name: Identified private box pallet
values.description: Identified private box pallet A box pallet identified as being privately owned.

values.name: Identified private flat pallet
values.description: Identified private flat pallet A flat pallet identified as being privately owned.

values.name: Platform
values.description: Platform A piece of equipment normally having a flat surface, or prepared for carrying cargo with a specific shape.

values.name: Protecting panel
values.description: Protecting panel A panel used for protection.

values.name: Portable stove
values.description: Portable stove A portable heating unit.

values.name: Flat car
values.description: Flat car A railway wagon without raised sides or ends.

values.name: Reefer generator
values.description: Reefer generator A generator used to control the temperature in temperature-controlled transport equipment.

values.name: Ground facility
values.description: Ground facility Storage tank or facility capable of receiving shipment of goods or commodity.

values.name: Rope
values.description: Rope Rope used in the securing of cargo.

values.name: Rail car
values.description: Rail car To identify that the equipment is a rail car.

values.name: Identified special pallet
values.description: Identified special pallet A pallet identified as special.

values.name: Strap
values.description: Strap A narrow strip of flexible material.

values.name: Swap body
values.description: Swap body Rectangular equipment unit without wheels, which can be mounted on a chassis or positioned on legs.

values.name: Trailer
values.description: Trailer A vehicle without motive power, designed for the carriage of cargo and to be towed by a motor vehicle.

values.name: Tarpaulin
values.description: Tarpaulin Waterproof material, e.g. canvas, to spread over cargo to protect it from getting wet.

values.name: Tackles
values.description: Tackles Identification of loading tackle used (sheets, ropes, chains, etc.), as specified in DCU 9 to CIM Article 13; and of containers, as specified in Articles 5 and 10 of Annex III to CIM (CIM 17).

values.name: Tarpaulin support
values.description: Tarpaulin support A device to support a tarpaulin.

values.name: ULD (Unit load device)
values.description: ULD (Unit load device) An aircraft container or pallet.
